metadata.title: Development and Validation of an SNP Marker for Identifying Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae Thai Isolates That Break xa5-Mediated Bacterial Blight Resistance in Rice

entities.name: SWEET11
entities.description: Rice SWEET susceptibility gene whose expression was induced by Xoo isolates in this study.

entities.name: SWEET14
entities.description: Rice SWEET susceptibility gene whose expression was suppressed by XooE6-positive isolates and induced by the XooE6-negative isolate in this study.

entities.name: xa5
entities.description: Recessive rice BB resistance gene studied in IRBB5 and related resistance-breaking Xoo isolates.

entities.name: xa13
entities.description: Rice BB resistance allele associated with the mutated SWEET11 promoter in IRBB13.

entities.name: Xa21
entities.description: Rice BB resistance gene carried by IRBB21.

entities.name: TFIIAγ5
entities.description: Transcription factor gamma subunit encoded by xa5; the paper states xa5 encodes TFIIAγ5 and disrupts interaction with TALEs.

entities.name: TFIIAγ1
entities.description: Basal TF gamma subunit mentioned as interacting with TALE proteins to activate SWEET14.

entities.name: PthXo1
entities.description: Xoo TALE reported to bind the SWEET11 promoter EBE and induce SWEET11 expression.

entities.name: PthXo2
entities.description: Xoo TALE reported to induce SWEET13 expression.

entities.name: PthXo3
entities.description: Xoo TALE reported to mediate activation of SWEET14.

entities.name: TalC
entities.description: Xoo TALE reported to activate SWEET14; the discussion also mentions TalC or Tal5 produced in African and most Asian Xoo strains.

entities.name: TalF
entities.description: Xoo TALE reported to mediate activation of SWEET14.

entities.name: Tal1c
entities.description: TALE effector in Xoo strain SK2-3 predicted to target SWEET11 and induce strong SWEET11 expression.

entities.name: AvrXa7
entities.description: Xoo TALE reported to mediate activation of SWEET14.

entities.name: SNP marker XooE6
entities.description: PCR-based SNP marker specific to IRBB5-compatible, xa5-mediated resistance-breaking Xoo isolates.

entities.name: SNP marker XooE8
entities.description: PCR-based SNP marker designed from Xoo16PK002 but not used for validation because of limited specificity.

entities.name: bacterial blight disease
entities.description: Rice bacterial blight disease caused by Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae.

entities.name: xa5-mediated resistance breaking
entities.description: Xoo virulence phenotype able to overcome xa5-mediated resistance in rice.

entities.name: compatibility with IRBB5
entities.description: Bacterial compatibility phenotype on rice variety IRBB5.

entities.name: compatibility with IRBB13
entities.description: Bacterial compatibility phenotype on rice variety IRBB13.

entities.name: partial resistance
entities.description: Intermediate resistance response reported for IRBB21 against both XooE6-positive and -negative strains.

entities.name: high resistance
entities.description: Resistance score category defined by lesion length 0-5 cm.

entities.name: moderate resistance
entities.description: Resistance score category defined by lesion length > 5-10 cm.

entities.name: moderate susceptibility
entities.description: Resistance score category defined by lesion length > 10-15 cm.

entities.name: susceptibility
entities.description: Resistance score category defined by lesion length > 15-20 cm.

entities.name: high susceptibility
entities.description: Resistance score category defined by lesion length > 20 cm.

relations.mechanism: The marker was developed to identify Xoo strains that break xa5-mediated resistance.
relations.evidence: This study aimed to develop a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) marker for precise identification of xa5-mediated resistance-breaking Xoo.

relations.mechanism: The Tal1c effector was predicted to target the SWEET11 EBE and induce strong SWEET11 expression.
relations.evidence: the Tal1c effector in the Xoo strain SK2-3 identified recently was predicted to target the EBE of SWEET11, subsequently inducing a strong expression of SWEET11 in rice variety IRBB5

relations.mechanism: PthXo1 binds the EBE on the SWEET11 promoter and induces SWEET11 expression.
relations.evidence: the EBE on the SWEET11 promoter binds to PthXo1 ... This interaction between the EBE and PthXo1 leads to the induction of SWEET11 expression
the expression of SWEET13 is induced by Xoo strains carrying PthXo2
the activation of SWEET14 is mediated by AvrXa7, PthXo3, TalC, and TalF
the activation of SWEET14 is mediated by AvrXa7, PthXo3, TalC, and TalF

relations.mechanism: The xa5 resistant recessive allele encodes TFIIAγ5.
relations.evidence: The xa5 resistant recessive allele in rice encodes a TF subunit TFIIAγ5

relations.mechanism: TFIIAγ5 disrupts interaction with TALEs, diminishing their ability to activate SWEET alleles.
relations.evidence: the xa5 resistant recessive allele in rice encodes a TF subunit TFIIAγ5, which disrupts the interaction with TALEs, consequently diminishing their ability to activate SWEET alleles

relations.mechanism: XooE6-positive isolates were identified as compatible with IRBB5.
relations.quantitative_effect: four positive Xoo isolates out of 64
relations.evidence: The SNP marker XooE6 conferred four positive Xoo isolates out of 64, including isolates Xoo16PK002, Xoo20PL010, Xoo20UT002, and Xoo strain SK2-3.

relations.mechanism: The marker identified isolates that break xa5-mediated resistance.
relations.evidence: XooE6 is specific to the IRBB5-compatible Xoo strains; therefore, XooE6 can be applied to identify Xoo strains that break xa5-mediated resistance in rice.

relations.mechanism: Upregulation of SWEET11 was associated with compatibility on IRBB5.
relations.evidence: In rice variety IRBB5, the expression level of SWEET11 dramatically increased nearly 150 folds at 7 DAI with four XooE6-positive Xoo isolates

relations.mechanism: SWEET14 was suppressed by XooE6-positive isolates in all tested varieties, while the XooE6-negative isolate induced SWEET14 in IRBB13.
relations.quantitative_effect: suppressed by all four XooE6-positive Xoo isolates; approximately 92 folds in IRBB13 with Xoo16PK001
relations.evidence: the expression of SWEET14 was suppressed by all four XooE6-positive Xoo isolates, but slightly induced by the XooE6-negative isolate Xoo16PK001 ... which significantly activated the expression of SWEET14 in IRBB13 and IRBB21, approximately 92 and 46 folds, respectively
